data: What is the maximum value of F1 for rare words appearing 5 times?

Looking at the graph, the "≤5 Avg" line shows the highest values among all the lines for rare words appearing 5 times. By examining the y-axis, which represents Dev Rare Word F1, the maximum value of this line appears to be around 4.
